headline: Nansha starts construction on Guangzhou's first ready-built residential plot, won for 1.907 billion yuan; floor price 7,980 yuan/sqm
summary: Construction has started on Guangzhou's first ready-built residential plot in Nansha. The land was won at auction for 1.907 billion yuan, with a floor price of 7,980 yuan per square metre.
why: Land auctions set the cost base for residential developers and are a closely watched gauge of property market activity in major Chinese cities. Land sales also feed local government revenue.
